newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE, Finland seeking CIS cargo link.
newsitem.headline: UAE, Finland seeking CIS cargo link.

text.p: Finland is trying to establish trade and cargo links with the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to cash in on the rich markets of the former Soviet Union, the English-langauge daily Gulf News reported on Wednesday.

"We are looking for a trade triangle comprising Jebel Ali (in Dubai), Lappeenranta and St Petersburg to service Russian and CIS markets," the paper quoted Finnish charge d'affaires in Abu Dhabi Caj Soderlund as saying.
"Finland has found Dubai and its Jebel Ali Free Zone to be leading in logistics to CIS and wants to tie up with the emirate," Soderlund said.
"Lappeenranta, which is situated close to St Petersburg, is aiming to be Russia's window to Europe, and through St Petersburg to cover the rest of the CIS with northern European goods," he added.

The paper said a Finnish trade delegation from Lappeenranta on the Russian borders would visit Dubai in March to discuss setting up the trade link with St Petersburg, the consolidation point for North European cargo into the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).
Dubai, UAE's second largest emirate and its commercial center, is an established hub for cargo to the southern CIS and Moscow markets.
